A water-Cherenkov tank 0.25 m deep (about 0.7 radiation lengths of water) and a 1-cm plastic scintillator sit side by side about 1000 m from the axis of a near-vertical 10^19.5 eV air shower. Estimate roughly what fraction of each detector's signal comes from muons. Is the contrast between the two fractions large enough to extract the muon fraction at each station with about 30% resolution? Explain briefly.
